runner.task_model_policy: All remaining and newly scheduled project tasks are locked to exact gpt-6-luna at high reasoning for implementation and all retry assessments, except tasks explicitly marked allow_reasoning_lock_xhigh=true with xhigh metadata. That narrow exception changes only the opted-in task's reasoning; the project model remains gpt-6-luna and all other tasks stay high. The shared Wiretail fallback is gpt-6-luna and generic escalation uses GPT-6 family IDs; historical completed-task model records are immutable.

runner.retry_sequence: For this project, execution_model_lock keeps the initial attempt, all substantive retries, and every separate assessment on gpt-6-luna/high unless a task explicitly opts into allow_reasoning_lock_xhigh. That narrow exception permits only its declared xhigh level and never changes the locked model. No model-family escalation is used.
runner.retry_assessment: No separate assessment before retry1; before retry2 and retry3, assessment uses the project-locked gpt-6-luna/high unless the task explicitly opts into allow_reasoning_lock_xhigh with xhigh assessment metadata. runner.block_escalation: Project recovery assessments remain gpt-6-luna/high except for tasks explicitly marked allow_reasoning_lock_xhigh=true with xhigh assessment metadata; the generic retry3 escalation map is bypassed by execution_model_lock.

completion_contract.native_mtp_context: equals resolved target per-sequence logical context L
completion_contract.native_mtp_residency: Turbo4 K/V entirely GPU-resident; never a target pager victim
completion_contract.target_cold_backing: canonical opaque Turbo4 K/V in CPU RAM; initial tail host-ready only after D2H completion
completion_contract.target_hot_capacity: dynamic H after full-L draft, weights, recurrent state, A workspace, scratch, GPU catalogue and reserve; no fixed70K/77K production constant
completion_contract.attention_path: GPU-native direct-paged or compressed mature FA chosen by matched shape/preparation/kernel/append timings; reference explicit oracle only
completion_contract.cold_proof: production GPU selector -> immutable submission -> completed H2D -> publication -> completed target consumption; controlled and organic claims separate
completion_contract.benchmark_identity: immutable build-time executable/DSO source receipt, observed endpoint process hashes, actual token geometry and exact paired original3prompt controls
completion_contract.speed_policy: Matrix105 uses the exact three canonical prompts, SSE, T=0 seed42, one 40-token warmup and three 400-token-maximum measured runs for each prompt at request-level reasoning off/low/medium/xhigh; GPU Turbo4 draft-MTP n-max2 stays enabled. Report per-prompt medians for decode tok/s, response-local MTP acceptance percent and fresh executed prefill tok/s, plus context-fill fresh-prefill curve. Freeze both binaries, source, helper, prompts, sampling and all launch settings before first measured row; no code/performance-config edits or rebuilds between configurations. Low results are findings, not failed tests.
completion_contract.scale_policy: Finish source repairs and coherent small paired retrieval/MTP proof first. The 105-03 L262144/H51200 trajectory and primary fact are executed, with occupancy-only proof and canonical 0/12. 105-03a validates split-document layout at L16384/H8192; 105-03b owns novel large scale, two additional recalls, and fresh canonical rows. Preserve per-request uncached prefill speed, cached input, decode, draft/accept counts and measured used/free VRAM as a compact curve. Actual fresh-process allocation accounting, not hypothetical duplicate reserve, governs admission. No smaller-H substitution for large proof, concurrent Qwen, forced route, per-token host retrieval or premature full-context diagnostic campaign. Missing optional telemetry is unknown. True execution failures get an ordered owner-specific repair; completed semantic/speed misses are findings, not unchanged retry loops. Fixed batch, <=16K fresh repo chunks and >=4096-token final reserve prevent context shift/compaction.
completion_contract.task_completion: Run named executable proofs and exact completion_check BEFORE state complete. Preserve usage/source/evidence on deliberate planning correction; reconcile derived current pointer. Missing measurement is not done; setup errors repaired in-task; true source defects get ordered repair and minimal retest, never an unreachable future dependency.
completion_contract.final_review: only current summary; actual ordered repair/benchmark/summary/review successors if goal unmet; no evidence-only retry loop
completion_contract.code_portability: dynamic model/device/memory geometry; server-specific material only in /srv/ai or .wiretail, separate metadata commits; no upstream publication
completion_contract.retrieval_semantics: final-user-span target Q; turn-boundary promote/diff; query-only hybrid checkpoint replay when history changes; frozen historical selection during generation
completion_contract.generation_semantics: R+G<=H; G guaranteed minimum, not output ceiling; recycle oldest clean host-backed generation-owned pages, never frozen history
completion_contract.host_semantics: inclusive canonical completed Turbo4 pages in pageable RAM plus bounded pinned staging; clean eviction mapping drop; no historical decode PCIe
